Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5417); Nathanaël (i.e. Nathanel), an Israelite and Christian:--Nathanael.
BiblicalUsage: Philip finds Nathanael and brings him to Jesus, and Jesus greets him as an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile. Nathanael is there again at the sea after the resurrection, among the disciples who see the risen Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Nathanael is the pattern of the honest seeker: he doubts, he comes and sees, and he stays. Jesus honours the man with no guile, and I want to be that kind of honest with Him.
